abstract: Leaf chlorophyll is a key indicator of physiological condition of plants. The aim of the present study was to investigate the relationships between different vegetation indices and chlorophyll content index values (CCI) in strawberry leaves from two varieties Asia and Alba. Twenty- four different vegetative indices were calculated using measured reflectance spectra of leaves in visible and short-wave near-infrared region. It was found that CARI, MCARI, mNDVI, Cl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">red edge</inf>, Cl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">green</inf>, REI1, REI2, and REI3 indices are more sensitive to leave's chlorophyll content. Linear, quadratic, logarithmic and compound predictive regression models, defining the relations between the CCI and the investigated vegetation indices for both varieties of strawberries, were calculated. The Compound model based on calculated vegetative indices for the Alba variety has the best fit for all tested indices. The highest coefficient of determination of 0.743 was found for CARI index. Quadratic model best describes the relationship between CCI and the investigated vegetation indices for the Asia strawberry variety. The best fit was found for REI2 index – the obtained coefficient of determination was 0.842. The results of the study show that it is possible to use different vegetative indices obtained by nondestructive remote sensing methods to estimate the chlorophyll content in strawberry leaves.

articleTitle: Impact of Two Energy Conservation Measures on Reducing CO2 Emissions
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The study uses saved energy (the expected annual economy of electrical energy) to describe the impact of energy conservation measures (ECM) on reducing CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions. Measure 1 (M1) is Reconstruction of the electric drive and control of a basic hoisting machine. Measure 2 (M2) is Reconstruction of the electric drive and control of a fan. A technological analysis for determining losses in percent without implementation of M1 and M2 was made. An investment analysis to determine energy savings in percent and in kWh/y with implementation of M1 and M2 was performed. The value in kWh/y is adjusted with a coefficient of emission factor (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) for electrical energy. Further research will involve an analysis of other energy conservation measures and their impact on the reduction of harmful emissions. In the long term and on a larger scale the improvement of the energy balance of technological systems will be favorable for slowing down climatic changes.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Key Factors Influencing the Outdoor Animal Recognition and Counting Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this study is performed an analysis of the key factors, influencing accuracy of outdoor animal recognition and counting. Initially, the commonly used sensors, their area of applications and mounting places are overviewed. Next, are analyzed a number of studies, dealing with counting and recognition of livestock and wild animals and their goals, methods used and data sources are summarized. The main factors, influencing the accuracy of recognition and counting algorithms include the px/m ratio of the images, the animal and environment color, the behavior of animals, the presence of artificial objects etc. The results show that many of them are common between livestock and wild animals but there are also some differences.

articleTitle: Impact of the method of air suction on the energy efficiency of fan systems
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents methods for improving the energy efficiency of fan systems using elements installed at the inlet of the suction pipe, in order to smoothly reduce the air flow to the relevant pipe sizes. Two cases are studied - when the suction is performed from "Unlimited space", as well as from limited space in the presence of a transverse wall. An indicator (coefficient kE) used to quantify the rate of improvement of the system energy efficiency by installing a suction element, evaluating what part is the particular improvement of energy efficiency based on the air suction pressure losses without installing an inlet body for improving suction, has been established. When using a suction cone, it is recommended that the taper angle be about 60<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sup> and a relative length L /D of not less than 0.2. Under these conditions, the reduction in inlet pressure losses is up to 0.9 compared to those without a suction cone installed. When using a smooth inlet, it is recommended that the relative radius should be R/D>0.1. For both studied methods of suction (from an unrestricted medium and from a transverse wall) the coefficient kE has values around 0.9.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Investigation of Thin Ceramic Plates by Means of Delay Line Contact Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The aim of this work is to investigate plates of Peltier modules by means of an ultrasonic method. A pulse-echo contact method was applied for precise measurement of thickness. Transducers with delay lines, emitting at 5 MHz, 10 MHz, 15 MHz and 20 MHz, were used to determine the operating frequency range. An analysis of a number of echoes, amplitude and shape of signals, pulse duration and pulse rise time was performed. Ceramic plates of six Peltier modules, models TEC1-12708 and TEC1-12710, were measured with a selected transducer of 15 MHz. Thicknesses at 25 points of each plate were determined. Variation of the obtained values is observed. Comparative analysis of the results for all measured plates can be used for quality evaluation of the modules.

articleTitle: A multidimensional comparative analysis of inverters used in wireless power transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of inverters used in the wireless transmission of electricity: fullbridge, half-bridge, half-bridge with mid-voltage point capacitors, class E. The inverter simulation was performed in Matlab Simulink using resistive and reactive loads (LC, RLC). The paper’s purpose is to achieve a multidimensional comparative analysis of each type of inverter used in high-frequency voltages coils supplying for wireless power transmission, determining the advantages and disadvantages for each type o load.

articleTitle: Physical properties of soaps obtained with the participation of plum kernel oil (Prunus domestica L.)
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The production of soaps has existed for centuries and the methods for assessing their quality are evolving in accordance with modern technological requirements, and are increasingly influenced by consumer preferences. For them, the functional properties that determine the effectiveness of the soap, ergonomic and aesthetic properties are important. The combination of these properties determines the quality of the soap. The purpose of this study was to determine the physical properties of soaps obtained with the participation of kernel oil from plums (Prunus domestica L.). There are five variants of soaps made from plum, palm and coconut oils in different proportions. The physical characteristics of the soaps were analyzed - hardness and stickiness, surface tension and a user evaluation was made. The results prove that the addition of kernel plum oil to the standard recipe (coconut/palm oil) in an amount of up to 20-30 %, has a positive effect on the properties of the soap. Plum kernel oil has the potential to be used in the production of soaps by the cold method.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Operation of Electric System by Radiocommunication Devices and Energy Consumption in Wastewater Treatment Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper describes the design and application of a monitoring system applicable in small and medium sized wastewater treatment plants. Experimentally, the system is currently applied in a wastewater treatment plant with a projected capacity for 1600 equivalent population, where operational data are monitored and acquired. The data are used to determine the technical condition of the equipment and to optimize the operating parameters, where electricity consumption is also monitored in relation to the amount of wastewater treated. The linear dependence of the energy consumed and the amount of wastewater treated during the period under study is further useful in the process of optimizing the operation. During the study period from January 2021 to December 2021, a total flow of 23 161 m3 and a total electricity consumption of 58 183 kWh were found in the wastewater treatment plant.

articleTitle: A Maturity Model as a Tool for Sustainable Development of Organizations
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper reviews maturity models, aiming to present the essence of self-assessment using a maturity model for quality, environmental and occupational health and safety management systems as a tool for achieving sustainable development of organizations considering that one of the goals of any organization is to achieve sustainable development in a complex and changing environment. As a future study, a methodology for determining the level of maturity through a maturity model of environmental management systems according to ISO 14001:2015 and occupational health and safety according to ISO 45001:2018 will be developed.

articleTitle: The Effect of a Special Form of the Piston Skirt Profile on Power Friction Losses in Internal Combustion Engines
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Pistons with altered form of the piston skirt contact area are presented in this paper. The efficiency of the new design has been evaluated by comparing the mechanical losses in the engines under equal operating conditions with conventional pistons and those with a special form of the contact surface. The use of such pistons does not change the degree of liquid friction. There is a significant change in the forces of dry friction at rest which is the reason for the friction power reduction and the mechanical losses of the pistons with a special form of the contact surface.

articleTitle: Water Erosion Hydrodinamical Impact on the Soil at Iirigation Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The researching and examinations of the irrigation processes, as well the processes causing erosion of the soil furrow beds and the alteration of their state in practice is done based on the flow velocities averaged-out in time. Through the hydraulic researches, it is known however that the real, actual velocities are pulsation velocities into the cross section of the water flow, which are irregularly variable in time and different from the averaged flow velocities. In view of this, in the present work the relations were realized on the basis of the pulsation velocities of the water flows. On this basis, a water erosion approach and method is offered for prediction of the erosive state and stability of the furrows for irrigation.

articleTitle: 3D Model of T-Shaped Inductor for Induction Brazing
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Induction brazing process of T-shaped copper tube assembly is reviewed and analyzed. Pipes are with significantly different sizes in diameter. 3D Numerical calculations are used for analysis and optimization of coil design choice and comparison. Electromagnetic field generated of two different type of coils are visualized and its heating effect is estimated in order to achieve proper processing.

articleTitle: Influence of Dynamically Changing Operating Conditions on the Content of Nitrogen Oxide in Old and New Diesel Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The conditions of actual operation of the vehicle in certain cases differ from the standard conditions of application of the relevant standard for determining the content of toxic components in the exhaust gases. This leads to an incorrect estimate of the absolute volume of toxic emissions released into the atmosphere. Nitrogen oxides in the exhaust gases of diesel cars are significantly affected by the dynamics of the operating mode, as well as the engine load. This trend is particularly negative for older diesel cars, which do not have the option of additional neutralization of exhaust gases. Under the conditions of the car fleet of the Republic of Bulgaria, which has an average age of 18 years, this problem is essential. For the objective assessment of the actual amount of nitrogen oxides emitted in the exhaust gases, planned experiments have been conducted in which extreme acceleration processes and loads of the car are artificially simulated. The experiments were performed on a car that meets the requirements of the EURO3 standard (18 years old) and on a new car according to the EURO 6D - TEMP standard. Conclusions have been made regarding the high level of neutralization of nitrogen oxides in the exhaust gases of vehicles with catalytic reduction.

articleTitle: Investigation of emulsion stability in Soybean protein isolates – Soybean oil – Water system
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate emulsion stability between soybean oil-water-soybean protein isolate (SI) system. The protein added as stabilizing emulsion, with different quantity 1 and 3 percent. Thermodynamic parameters Gibbs free energy, enthalpy and entropy for each emulsion were calculated. The samples of emulsions prepared with different pH interval. Microscopic observations and turbidity of all emulsions were prepared and used for determined stability of presented emulsions.

articleTitle: Using Solar Energy to Power an Agricultural Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a system for charging of the agro robot battery. Possibilities to assure needed electric energy for agro robot motion and operation are analyzed. A solar charging system is developed and described. The obtained electric energy from solar charging system at variable solar radiation intensity is studied. The variation of charging output power was registered and efficiency of the solar charging system at different hours of day was evaluated and presented. The results show that in a summer day, the solar energy can assure operation of the agro robot up to approximately 10 hours.

articleTitle: Quantifying the values of selected KPIs of on-farm using statistical methods of analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this research, various key performance indicators in livestock production are analyzed. Based on this analysis, a list of several indicators has been identified to meet the needs of the farm animal population follow-up study. A statistical analysis of the sample data was used to quantify the values of one of these indicators. Through frequency analysis and histogram, the frequency distribution of the study values was graphically visualized. The mean values were evaluated by analysis of variance (ANOVA).

articleTitle: Presentation of a New Technology for Incineration of Municipal Solid Wast (MSW)
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This article presents a technology for the incineration of MSW, the purpose of which is to avoid some problems and issues in the currently existing and applied technologies. The technical tasks meant to be solved by us are in the following directions: 1. To design a technology for the implementation of a plant for the incineration of MSW applicable for the generation of a small amount of domestic waste, namely - from 50 to 100 tons per day; 2. Maximum/almost complete/ energy recovery, namely - the generated heat to be supplied to the district heating network , and the electricity - to the electricity grid; 3. Residual ash after the incineration process may be used as a filler in concrete mixtures and as a base layer in road construction; 4. To reach high environmental standards.

articleTitle: The influence of catalyst (p-TSA) weight percentage on reaction rate during the oleic acid esterification process with trimethylolpropane
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the present work the kinetics of the acid-catalyzed esterification reaction of oleic acid with trimethylolpropane was described, by carrying out of the process under vacuo at 120°C and applying different weight percentage (w%) of p-TSA as a catalyst. The reaction was studied at following percents of p-TSA: 0 w%, 0.5 w%, 1 w% and 5 w% and the duration time of 1200 min. The reaction kinetics was monitored by analyzing the acid value of the aliquots taken from the mixture. Authors noticed that the highest reaction rate of the process as well as the best results in regard to the yield of the obtained product were achieved using 5 w% of p-TSA. However, darkening of the mixture was observed, probably due to the oxidation process, which reduces the purity and quality of the resulting product. Moreover, some problems with product purification during washing of the reaction mixture were observed, probably due to increasing of emulsification properties of reaction mixture at higher weight percents of catalyst. Therefore, in order to select the optimal reaction conditions, the percent of catalyst must be precisely selected by variations in the range between 2 w% and 5 w% p-TSA relative to oleic acid.

articleTitle: Equipment and Methodology for State of Charge Determination in Lithium - ion Batteries at Different Operating Modes
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The goal of this study is to propose experimental equipment and methodology for determination of the available energy in single lithium - ion batteries under different load profiles and environmental conditions. The presented equipment and methodology of work are easy to implement, cost-efficient and allow research of the influence of various parameters on the available energy stored in lithium - ion batteries.

articleTitle: Identification of Lighting Clouds Presented by Electric Dipole
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Identification of a moving lightning cloud is being carried out. The lightning cloud is seen as an electric dipole. The electromagnetic field distribution in moving environments is considered. For determination of the electromagnetic field, electromagnetic model and relativistic approach are used. A four-dimensional potential is applied. The magnetic vector potential and the scalar electric potential are the elements of four-dimensional potential. The Maxwell tensor is used to determine the vectors of the electromagnetic field. The electric field vector components of the electric dipole are obtained. The quality of dipole charge, its coordinates and velocity are determined by solving the inverse problem. To solve the inverse problem, the obtained analytical expressions for the components of the electric field, created by a moving electric dipole, are used.

articleTitle: About the methodology for working a robot to destroy weeds
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Globally, there is an increased demand for fresh agricultural products. It contains vital elements for maintaining people's health. Traditional technologies and principles of growing crops will not lead to the desired increase to this agricultural production.The new technologies will be created or some of these traditional technologies will be changed to respond to market needs. The first step is to use principally new or innovative mechanized technologies to increase yields. One such technology is that of weed control and destroy without human intervention. This will free up human resources for other operations. In this case, are rely on an autonomous system for long-term cultivation and weed control.This article discusses the highlights of such a technology for weed control without human intervention. These highlights are the positioning of the robot in the plantation, the exact location of its position and data retrieval of meteorological and soil conditions, the transmission and reception of data via IoT as well as artificial intelligent control. Other important points are the preparation of the equipment, the destruction of weeds system and artificial intelligence control of mobile robot. The destruction itself is carried out with hot air, paying attention to the temperature of the hot air, the duration and direction of heating.

articleTitle: Structural–functional model of the students’ adaptation process to the European Credit Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The relevance of the problem under study is caused by the need to implement new educational models that meet international standards. The article is devoted to the problem of students’ adaptation to the European Credit Transfer System (ECTS). The purpose of the article is to build a structural-functional model of the students’ adaptation process to ECTS. The theoretical and methodological basis for building the model was a systematic approach, the essence of which lies in the fact that relatively independent components are considered in their interconnection and development. As a result of theoretical analysis and generalization of the empirical material obtained during the study, the term "adaptation to ECTS" is defined. The structure and functions of the model are determined. The model is characterized by three related components (motivational-targeted, content-technological, result-evaluative) and is based on a system of principles. Each component performs its own functions. Special attention is paid to the levels of formation of students’ readiness for educational activities in ECTS environments. Materials of the article can be useful to the experts working in educational institutions, to students, and to everyone who is connected with the field of education.

articleTitle: Bi-level optimization of ship transportation by collision avoidance and fuel consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The ship management in collision avoidance is important task, which is a prerequisite for unmanned automation of maritime transportation. The formal, quantified modeling of the needed path changes is a vitally needed to provide safe management of the ship and to provide secure policy in collision avoidance. A second criterion coming from cost reduction of the ship exploitation and environment protection matter is related with fuel consumption in path planning. This research develops a formal model which targets simultaneously goals for safe avoidance of collision in a faster way and also to minimize the fuel consumption. These both targets are formalized by bi-level optimization. The research presents this bi-level model which is implemented in optimization problem. The results from numerical simulations prove close results with the ship simulator and give evidences for efficiency of ship management and path planning.

articleTitle: M-Learning - Before and During COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The report describes a study of the opinion of students from the University of Ruse on their use of mobile learning before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. The research uses the survey methodology and for this purpose an online questionnaire was developed. A total number of 469 students from four academic years were surveyed - two before COVID-19 and two during the pandemic. Of the total number of surveyed students, 143 are in the academic year 2021-2022 and 133 are in the academic year 2020-2021, when most of the education was online. 72 are in the academic year 2019-2020 and 121 are in the academic year 2018-2019. An analysis and comparison of the results of these three academic years was performed. Relevant conclusions about the impact of COVID-19 on the use of mobile learning are made.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Pulse Methods for DC Motor Control
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this article comparative analysis of the results of research of two methods for pulse control of a DC brush motor is made. A control circuit with addition of energy in control pulses for the motor anchor winding has been designed. The results of experimental researches of consumed electric power, output mechanical power and efficiency in the conventional method and in the method with addition of energy are presented. It has been realized theoretical analysis of transients in the control pulses for the motor in both control methods.

articleTitle: Study of the possibilities for optimization of reactive power according to the criterion "electric power quality" in the power supply system of a port complex
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents an opportunity to optimize the reactive powers in the power supply system (PSS) of the port complex of Burgas. Based on the general energy characteristic of the object and synthesized theoretical statement, in the conditions of asymmetric and non-sinusoidal loading. Instrumental measurements and analyzes were performed, with the help of which quantitative ratios for the different partial losses were established and finally the total losses of active power were determined. It was found that the compensation of reactive loads in the conditions of deteriorated electric energy (EE) quality does not ensure good results. In this regard, a significantly better and more efficient technical solution developed according to the criterion of "high quality EE" is proposed. The practical implementation of the proposal guarantees the achievement of energy efficiency, significant EE savings and a payback period of the facilities within (1.8 ÷ 3.1) years.

articleTitle: Intuitionistic Fuzzy Estimations of Implementation of Port Knocking on Routeros
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The article presents one of the aspects affecting network security, in particular accessibility to communication devices by executing a sequence of rules for a specific time interval. Intuitionistic fuzzy estimators were used to calculate the degrees of membership non-membership and hesitation margin of the packets falling into the allowed lists. Generalized nets and indexed matrices are used to modeling the processes described port knocking.

articleTitle: Evaluation of β-carotene content in apricots during the drying process using visual and near-infrared spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Non-destructive applications for the detection of food quality, especially internal properties, are highly relevant for process control in the food industry. In this respect, visible and near-infrared spectroscopy (VIS and NIR) were evaluated and compared for their ability to predict β-carotene content in apricots. Two regions called VIS-NIR from 400–1000 nm and called NIR from 900–1700 nm regions were analyzed for prediction ability. In the paper two types of regression models that present the β-carotene content are used: partial least square regression (PLSR) and support vector machine regression (SVMR) developed in both spectrum ranges, with good results for coefficient of determination (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and standard errors of cross-validation (RMSECV). The best model performance for calibration and validation is obtained using SNV->SG pre-treatment with PLS and SVM regressions in the VIS-NIR range. The performance measurements are as follows: R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>c=0.91 and RMSEC=20.1 for calibration and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>v=0.84 and RMSEV=27.1 for validation. On the other hand Support Vector Machine Regression (SVMR) has the following results: R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>c=0.92 and RMSEC=19.2 for calibration and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>v=0.84 and RMSEV=26.7 for validation. When using second derivative Savitzky-Golay (SG’’) both models showed a poor performance. On the basis of the developed models the polynomial linear regression and equations are developed to evaluate the β-carotene content during the apricots drying process. The results show that the both ranges VIS-NIR and NIR can be used for non-destructive and reliable determination of β-carotene content in apricots using different kinds of predictive models. In this study the best model is obtained in the VIS-NIR range. The conclusion is that there is a work to be done for improving the prediction. The variance of the drying process model is still large. Despite the closeness between the reference values and the predicted ones, the error in estimating the concentration is still not satisfactory.

articleTitle: Inventory planning in livestock management
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This research applies quantitative approach for the development of inventory policy, addressing livestock management. The inventory policy targets raw supply in time for the livestock management. Simultaneously such policy has to respect a decrease of the costs, which are encountered for the implementation of the inventory tasks. This research derives analytical model for minimization of the costs of inventory set up requests and the holding costs during the stay of raw materials in warehouses. Optimization problem is derived, which solutions define the amount of inventory and the point, when a new order has to be placed. The added value of this problem is its explicit probabilistic constraint considering the stochastic nature of the demands. Thus, the inventory policy is defined to minimize simultaneously the costs for making orders and the holding costs for the received materials. This optimization is subject to a stochastic constraint, originated by the non-deterministic nature of the livestock demand. Numerical simulations and graphical interpretations illustrate the new derived inventory policy.

articleTitle: Power electronic drive circuit for DC motor with addition of energy
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this article an analysis of experimental results obtained from the study of a driver circuit for pulse control of a DC motor with the addition of energy in control pulses is made. A comparative analysis with control by conventional method is made. The results of realized research are shown in tabular and graphical form. Oscillograms of the change in current consumed by two control drivers are shown, as well as oscillograms of applied voltage and current through the armature winding of the motor. An analysis of the obtained experimental results was made.

articleTitle: Innovative Approach in the Implementation of an Electronic System for Monitoring and Control of Production Processes
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The report addresses issues related to a comprehensive analysis of the elements of the system for monitoring industrial processes. Methods for managing the technological process on a completely new basis by assessing current parameters to ensure the efficiency of production processes and the ability to manage the system according to the presented indicators are presented. The synthesized electronic system for monitoring and control of industrial processes provides technological security and high quality of the final product. The conducted research proves that the obtained experimental results and estimates fall within the permissible limits determined by the standards. A human-machine interface to an electronic system has been developed to qualify the finished product and achieve efficiency, accuracy in monitoring and control of production processes, as well as visualization of the received evaluation.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of thermal pollution caused by coal-fired power plant
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this paper, analysis of thermal pollution from thermal power plants is carried out. This analysis is done with the use of numerical simulation. A two-dimensional numerical model was proposed and numerical results are obtained by using the Fluent software package. Four scenarios were considered, where scenario 1 represents a flow ratio of the discharge channel and the Sava River of 3% and scenario 4 a flow ratio of 12%. With the appearance of increasing droughts, the flow of rivers also decreases. As the river flow decreases, the ratio of discharge channel and river flow increases. The analysis will show that the higher this ratio, the greater the negative impact on the living world in the river. Namely, there is an increase in the heat load of the river. In the numerical simulations, the initial river temperature was taken as the arithmetic mean temperature in the summer months for the previous five years, before reaching the Nikola Tesla B thermal power plant itself. When scenario 1 is compared with the scenario 4, one can notice that by changing the flow of the Sava River and for the same inlet temperature, the river temperature is higher for the scenario 4 at distance of 2000m after the discharge.

articleTitle: Bioconversion of Lemna sp and Nejayote into Biogas as a starting point for agrowaste
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Agrowaste has some issues such as management or disposal in the transformation industry of corn and pig farms. Sub-products obtention from waste of both industries can represent an opportunity if processes are technically and economically feasible. In this study, bioconversion of Lemna sp and Nejayote in biogas via anaerobic digestion was evaluated at short term as function of biogas production, as well as chemical oxygen demand (COD) and total solid (TS) removal. Lemna sp was collected from a pond system applied for wastewater treatment of pig farms, while Nejayote, the wastewater generated in the nixtamalization process of corn, was collected in a local corn processing store. Results indicated that the digesters with Lemna sp generated up to 32% higher biogas than that for Nejayote. This is also reflected in the biogas yield obtained, 0.31 L of biogas/ g COD and 0.46 L of biogas/ g COD for Nejayote and Lemna sp, respectively. Regarding biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) removal, the evaluation of the substrates indicated a greater removal of BOD present in the reactors with Lemna sp, reaching an average of 79% of BOD removed in 120 h, for a 37% removal in the reactors with Nejayote. On the other hand, an increase in the concentration of total COD was observed in both substrates, demonstrating the potential solubilization of the particulate material present in both substrates. Although the Lemna sp reactors increased the concentration of TS, a fraction may be attributable to the development of microorganisms typical of anaerobic digestion. On the contrary, in the case of digesters with Nejayote, a decrease in TVS and an increase in COD are observed simultaneously. This could be due to increase is closely related to the hydrolysis of the organic material present in the anaerobic digesters. In general, methanogenic viability were more suitable for the Lemna sp conversion at the conditions applied and the same COD load of both substrates.

articleTitle: Solar-thermal collector energy optimisation based on optimum input temperature mode
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper present a mathematical model to find the optimum input temperature of a solar-thermal collector for a known set of climate data, using solar radiation and external temperature over the hot and cold period of the year. In the study, is presented the mathematical model of solar-thermal collector functionality over the day coupled with a thermal storage tank and a mixing valve, able to prepare the optimal temperature of thermal agent from the system. The optimum temperature of thermal agent at input plug of solar system is evaluated based on solar radiation and temperature of eternal air to take the maximum of renewable energy. In the modeling a prestudy of solar-thermal collector functionality is driven to propose the efficiency and functionality state chart of solar-thermal collector for specific climate data.

articleTitle: Assessment of urban traffic control by application of bi-level optimization model
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Bi-level optimization model with two control variables-green light duration and cycle durations is developed in order to decrease the queue lengths of vehicles at crossroads. A comparison of the bi-level solutions with a one-criterion optimization problem is done. An assessment of the comparison is presented giving an advantage to the bi-level optimization model.

articleTitle: Influence of Pre-Sowing Electromagnetic and Chemical Treatment on Sowing Qualities of Maize Seeds
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The possibilities were studied for pre-sowing electromagnetic treatment of maize seeds, with or without prior fungicidal disinfection, at different fill levels of the space between the electrodes with seed material.It was established that the pre-sowing electromagnetic treatment of maize seeds should be performed after their disinfection with fungicide. Following that, by applying a voltage of 1,65 kV between the electrodes for a duration of treatment 10 s, an increase in the number and weight of the harvested cobs of up to 6,0%, and 9,9%, respectively, was achieved as compared to the reference specimen.

articleTitle: A Study related to the influence of the speed of a Machine-tractor aggregate and soil moisture on plowing depth
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The influence of soil moisture and operational speed of a machine-tractor aggregate on plowing depth were investigated. The study is based on a one-year field try on the territory of Chirpan Region, in the central part of Bulgaria (42°09'07"N25°20'54E). Experiments were conducted on two parcels with sizes – 1000 m length and 45 m width. The technological operation Plowing was carried out with a five-corpus turning plow, aggregated to a tractor with 200 hp at two speeds – 4.5 km/h and 6 km/h. The momentous soil moisture was measured with a soil moist meter AM-128 SOIL in different points of the experimental field before conducting the technological operation. The actual working depth received after the operation with the machine-tractor aggregate was measured using a linear meter. Based on the applied ANOVA it was established that the average values of the parameter Plowing Depth at both aggregate working speeds were statistically significant at a level p < 0.05. The correlation analysis registered strong positive relation between the Aggregate Speed and Plowing Depth (r = 0.923), as well as a strong negative correlation between the Soil Moisture and Aggregate Speed (r = -0.943), and between Soil Moisture and Plowing Depth (r = -0.860). A multivariate regression analysis was applied related to the influence of aggregate s working speed and soil moisture to keep the assigned plowing depth. Two regression models were compared (Linear and Non-linear). According to the received coefficients of determination, the Linear model (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 0.968) described well the relations between the examined parameters, but the Non-linear model was more appropriate (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> = 0.977). Taking into account the graphics describing the Non-linear regression model it was established that the assigned working depth of the machine-tractor aggregate could be kept at the moisture of 70-80% and aggregate speed of 4.5-5 km/h.

articleTitle: Opportunities for rationalization the electricity consumption of a port complex
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The research on the different characteristics of the power supply system (PSS) of a port complex is done in order to identify measures to improve the operating modes. In general, the features and requirements for the power supply and electrical equipment of the site are presented and the main energy parameters of the main consumers are marked. A theoretical formulation of the study has been synthesized, giving the opportunity to make an analysis of the characteristic coefficients of energy consumption and the additional power losses from the unevenness of the load schedule. A total of seven power substations and 11 outputs were examined and the measurements were performed with professional network analyzers. The results are presented in tabular form and provide an opportunity to make a thorough analysis of the state of the PSS of the site. Based on them, technological solutions can be offered to rationalize the electricity supply and achieve savings in electricity.

articleTitle: Filtration Flows in a Ground Field and Contamination Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This treatise considers the real length of filtration flow in a porous field (soil), i.e. the velocity of the water movement along porous grooves, where the process of interaction between the filtration flow and the field takes place, which predetermines its condition of rest. This process cannot be observed, predicted and controlled through the mean velocities of filtration flow only. In fact, in a porous field (soil) the water particles move along porous grooves (channels) of curved trajectories circumambulating the particles of the field. Each of these trajectories has a different length and upon given specific conditions – type and condition of the porous field - have certain repetitiveness. For the adopted initial conditions in the treatise, an analytical dimensioning relationship has been established to determine the real length of the trajectory of filtration flow in a porous grooves, as well as the length of contaminant transport by filtration flow.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Meteorological Factors Affecting the Efficient Use of Electricity in Water Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The increasing prices of electricity are a prerequisite to seek solutions to reduce electricity consumption in all areas of economy. Methodological guidelines are presented for the study of the meteorological factors affecting the efficient use of electricity in water supply systems by employing the expert evaluation method. The stepwise regression method is used to derive models for the variation of the average values of electrical load with temperature and precipitation at a small village, a basis for creating a model for the management of a water supply system aimed at reducing its electricity consumption.

articleTitle: A new method for testing Peltier modules
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of the application of a new approach to the study of thermoelectric components. Six single-stage Peltier modules, models TEC1-12706 and TEC1-12706SR, were measured. A pulse-echo contact ultrasonic technique and 10 MHz frequency dual transducer was used to determine thicknesses of ceramic plates at many points of their surfaces. Variation of the results for different modules and plates were obtained. Additional reliability factor was introduced to estimate the temperature deviations as a function of thickness. Comparative results of studied modules can be used for quality selection in the design of electronic components and devices. The proposed ultrasonic method for measuring the thickness of ceramic plates is effective enough to be part of the control and testing procedure.

articleTitle: Statistical models for observation the uniformity of the working depth of machine-tractor unit during disking and cultivation depending on soil moisture
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The uniformity of operation of a machine-tractor unit, influenced by the current soil moisture has been studied, and regression models describing the relations between them were developed. The study was based on three years of field experience in an area of 32400 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in central Bulgaria (42°08′04″N25°21′31″E). The following tillage system was applied: first agricultural year (FAY) – triple disking with cultivation; second agricultural year (SAY) – double disking with rolling; third agricultural year (TAY) – triple disking. The disking was conducted with a tractor with a power of 200 hp. and a six-meter mounted disc harrow, and the Cultivation with an eight-meter cultivator aggregated to a tractor with 240 hp. Data on the instantaneous soil moisture was taken with a soil moisture meter AM-128 SOIL. The working depths of the disking and cultivation operations were measured with a linear meter. During the harvest, the following average yields were obtained: FAY-628kg/da, SAY-603kg/da, and TAY-545kg/da. Calculated correlation coefficients show a very strong correlation between soil moisture in the three observed years and the depth of disking (r=0.769; 0.790; 0.937). A weak, negative correlation (r=-0.172) has been reported between soil moisture and depth of cultivation. Statistically significant differences between depths of disking for the three observed years were found. From all regression models compiled for the first and second agricultural years, the Quadratic model best describes the influence of soil moisture on the depth of disking (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.903, 0.617), and for the third agricultural year - the Cubic model (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.667). No statistically significant regression models describing the relation between instantaneous soil moisture and the depth of cultivation were found. Statistically significant differences between the mеan yield in the FAY and TAY, as well as between the SAY and TAY were reported. The depth of disking affects the productivity of wheat by 36.2%.

Index Terms: Years Of Experience In The Field

articleTitle: Determining the Planned Error of a Measurement Transducer with a Pointer
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of determining the planned (theoretical) error of a measurement transducer. The effect of all components on the position of the final actuated component of the dimensional chain is analyzed in detail. The planned error of a measurement transducer with a constant (graduation) of i = 0,001 mm is determined.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Processes in a Ship 's Bow Thruster with Synchronous Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Bow thrusters are used in marine vessels, ships and boats. Bow thrusters are propulsion devices who improve maneuverability of the ship. They enable easy movement of a ship in confined areas and also for docking purposes. The article proposes a mathematical model of a ship power plant feeding a bow thruster based on a synchronous reluctance motor. With the help of the model, different modes of operation of the power plant were studied, as well as transient modes caused by the control system, as well as by disturbances from the external environment.

articleTitle: Influence of Non-traditional Organic Fertilizers on Spring Wheat Harvest and Carbon Dioxide Emission from Soil
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The influence of non-traditional organic fertilizers on the yield and quality of spring wheat of the Lyubava variety was determined. During the research, the following nontraditional organic fertilizers were used: biohumus, Golden Fairy biofertilizer (biosludge from biogas production) and manure. The studies were carried out under the conditions of a microfield experiment, in nitrogen-equivalent doses. The influence of the use of manure, mineral fertilizers in an equivalent dose and their combination on the main indicator of grain quality - the content of crude protein was studied. The amount of carbon dioxide emissions from the soil from the application of vermicompost and residues from biogas production was determined in com-parison with the application of manure.

articleTitle: Harmonic Compensation in Ship Power System Using p-q Theory Control Based Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Nowadays, with the increased proliferation of nonlinear loads used in the ship's power systems, the issue of improving and maintaining the power quality is rising as well. The caused deterioration can lead to disturbance in the operation of the electrical equipment and overall disruption of the system stability. To avoid these consequences, different approaches, such as the application of passive, active filters, or other devices, can be used. The present paper describes the implementation of a shunt active power filter (SAPF) with a p-q theory-based control system in a ship's electrical power system, aiming to reduce the total harmonic distortion (THD) at the point of common coupling (PCC) of nonlinear loads. By proposition of an accurate mathematical model of a ship's power system and simulation of different case studies, the disturbance in the system with and without SAPF connected is observed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Traction Motor Drive of Electrical Vehicle: Types, Performances and Control
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The development, improvement and use of electric vehicles is one of the fastest growing areas of electrical engineering. This is due to their undoubted qualities and environmental requirements. One of the most important elements of electric cars is the traction motor drive. The article reviews types, performances and control drives. The main parameters, characteristics of electrical drives are considered, indicating their advantages and disadvantages, their use in different types of cars. Particular attention is paid to the methods and means of control of electrical drives, which largely determines the control characteristics of the electric vehicle, their efficiency and their mileage.

articleTitle: Main Trends in the Organization of the Postgraduate Research and Education Process in the Context of Digitalization of Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The relevance of implementing digital learning environment is that digital technologies influence the level of development. Therefore, the state and society need specialists capable of operating the most sophisticated equipment, devices and robots to remain globally competitive. In the context of the global transformation of education, it is necessary to nurture professionals capable of rapidly adapting to the ever-improving modern educational processes and technologies. Digitalization serves as a tool for innovative development of higher education, changing the demand for professions and competencies of university graduates. A specific feature of the digital transformation of education should be the creation and mass dissemination of new models of educational organizations based on new high-performance teaching practices and methods, which are successfully implemented in the digital educational environment.

articleTitle: Smart Dairy Farm - Digitalization and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Digitalization is an important part of modern agriculture. Digital dairy farming is developing based on modern digital technologies. These technologies allow the formation of a sufficient cloud of data in accordance with the physiological and technological requirements of different categories of dairy cattle. The article assesses the development of various digital technologies together with biometric sensors and blockchain technologies in dairy cattle breeding, respectively in a modern dairy farm. The tendencies and perspectives for digital innovation and digitalization of dairy farms and complexes are studied. It is concluded that the main factors influencing the development of digital technologies in dairy farming are their price, validity and response time. The aim of the current study is to make a retrospective review, characterization and analysis of modern scientific achievements of various digital technologies and systems applied in the technological cycle of dairy cattle breeding.

articleTitle: Perspective of education in Agriculture 4.0 in selected countries in European Union and Palestine
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: To achieve the aim to foster competitive and sustainable agriculture and forestry sector that "achieves more from less" - which is the one of the main aims of the precision farming - is necessary to bring together innovation actors (farmers, advisors, researchers, businesses, NGOs, etc.) and help to build bridges between research and practice, thus positioning at the core of the innovations in agriculture. Precision Agriculture is an innovative concept, not specifically about the technologies, but about the overall concept putting the accent on understanding how the technologies can make farming more accurate and controlled. The research, presented in this article, has been done in the framework of the BENEFIT project (609544-EPP-1-2019-1-PS-EPPKA-CBHEJP) which runs under the Erasmus+ Capacity Building for Higher Education program and its innovative character serves not only the capacity-building aspect for Palestinian universities, but also addresses the challenges faced by Palestine regarding the integration of the newest (digital) technologies into agriculture and rural development.The article presents perspectives of education in Precision Agriculture and Agriculture 4.0 in selected countries in the European Union - Slovakia, Czech Republic, and Palestine.

articleTitle: Peculiarities and trends of national environmental policies of countries
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The current crisis phenomena in the economies of most countries have a major impact on the implementation of the main directions of environmental policy related to the policy of replacing energy resources with "clean" ones that do not pollute the atmosphere and do not harm living organisms and the environment. The impact of the crisis can slow down the implementation of many policy points in developed countries, including the European Union. The article examines the experience of implementation of environmental policy of the European Union, presents the main concepts and ways of development of new economic models (in particular, the green economy) of some developed countries, and also investigates the directions of transition to renewable energy sources (RES) in developing countries. In the course of the study some indicators of economic efficiency of the undertaken measures and their results are considered. Russia's resource-export model is unstable and a dead end, which is recognized by politicians and scientists alike. Development based on the depletion of natural resources cannot be sustainable in the long term. The country is in search of a new model, which can be a model of green economy.

articleTitle: Portable on-site testing system for hydrokinetic turbines
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper describes the development and preliminary testing of a portable on-site testing system suitable for hydrokinetic turbines. In order to estimate the power produced by a full-scale hydrokinetic turbine in prototype phase, it is necessary to study several similar models on a progressive scale and to test them on dedicated benches, in laboratory conditions. The characterization of increased diameter rotors requires larger models that often exceed the test capabilities of the hydraulic laboratory test benches. In this case, testing should be performed on-site, in real operating conditions. In this regard, a specially designed test system that can characterize the hydrokinetic rotors with larger diameters in rivers or channels with significant velocities has to be used. The main advantages of such a testing system are that the rotors are easily swappable, the electronic and electric parts are placed outside the water and there is no need for grid connection, due to low power requirements. Thus, the system can be deployed only by using a laptop and a battery pack, making it suitable for remote areas. The purpose of the experiments described in this paper was to determine the characteristic parameters like power, mechanical torque or power coefficient for hydrokinetic rotors with same geometry but different diameters. This testing method is fast and accurate and contributes to a better understanding of horizontal axis hydrokinetic turbines.

articleTitle: Online Education: Modern Management in University systemy
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The Internet and the World Wide Web (www) have fundamentally changed the practice of distance teaching and distance learning which has evolved over the past years. Today, online learning begins to really replace the full-time form of acquiring knowledge. Russian universities are actively introducing online courses designed to replace classes within the walls of educational institutions. Thousands of educational institutions have already adapted various forms of online education for their needs. Review and consideration of the sources and trends of modern online learning is an important step towards it.The authors base their research on the analysis and synthesis of Russian and international experience evolving main characteristics of modality types of e-learning, online-learning and distance learning. ICTs have the potential to facilitate collaboration, exchange and access to learning resources. MOOCs concept can be applied in the system of higher full-time and part-time education through the mechanisms of creating mixed forms that combine a face-to-face approach (usually in the form of tutoring), online lectures and practical classes.

articleTitle: Identification, Vulnerability Research and Cybersecurity of Raspberry Pi Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: With the development of IoT technology, integration and remote management of almost all devices, that should be able to satisfy everyday needs in the evolving "smart" society, has been significantly accelerated. On the other hand, connecting more and more smart devices poses the challenges of how to protect them effectively from remote malicious interference. An important aspect of student’s learning is the acquisition of practical knowledge and skills related to the use of "smart" devices. Many of these devices are based on the use of typical operating systems, thus the experience that is gained based on studying a particular structure is transformed relatively easily and quickly to any system. The purpose of this work is to identify and investigate vulnerabilities and develop relevant effective protection for Raspberry Pi devices. The study was conducted using real and virtual Raspberry Pi's, thus enabling to simulate and model a particular type of attack and penetration method.

articleTitle: Measures to stimulate the development of electric transport as a tool for the development of the territory
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Sustainable development of the territory depends on the development of projects related to the organization of transport, namely the production and use of electric transport. Considering social, environmental factors, electric transport is an important tool to ensure environmental safety of the territory. The main purpose of this study is to summarize the positive experience of foreign countries, the systematization of state support measures, as well as identifying the main trends in the development of electric transport. The article presents a generalization of planned and mandatory indicators for the development of electric transport in the country. These mandatory indicators are aimed at achieving zero greenhouse gas emissions from transport. Systematic methods to promote electric vehicles in the EU, including through reducing the cost of paying transport tax, financial support for electric vehicle industry, public procurement of electric vehicles, providing free parking spaces for electric vehicles, providing free charging at public stations, access to restricted areas or city centers for cars with low pollution, support for training measures to promote the use of electric vehicles, road toll exemptions or discounts Systematized measures to stimulate the development of electric vehicles in the European Union, which allowed to propose a generalized world policy structured in four categories - legislation, objectives, plans and proposals. Through 4 groups of development - financial, infrastructural, ecological and informational.

articleTitle: The influence of temperature on reaction rate during the oleic acid esterification process with trimethylolpropane
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The kinetics of the acid-catalyzed esterification of oleic acid with trimethylolpropane (monitored by analyzing the acid value of the aliquots taken from the mixture) was carried out under vacuum and studied at following temperatures: 90, 105, 120 and 150°C, using 1% of p-TSA as a catalyst and the duration time of 1200 min. The observed reaction rate of the process was the highest at a temperature of 150°C in comparison with the other studied reaction temperatures. In addition, when carrying out the reaction at 120°C and 150°C, the yields were almost the same, as shown by the close final acid values at 1200th minute, which were 2.71 mg KOH/g and 2.5 mg KOH/g respectively. But they were significantly lower than acid values observed at 90°C and 105°C, which were 5.66 mg KOH/g and 4.35 mg KOH/g respectively. However, as the temperature rises, the possibility of side reactions with the formation of undesired products increases. Therefore, based on the experiment, in order to select the optimal reaction conditions, the reaction temperature must be precisely selected by variations in the range between 105°C and 120°C. Further studies of the model reaction will be performed in order to select the optimal temperature and the optimal amount of p-TSA, which on the one hand effectively catalyzes the rapid course of the reaction and on the other hand does not cause other undesirable processes such as emulsification and darkening of the reaction mixture. The latter lead both - to difficulties in the purification of the final product and to the deterioration of its commercial qualities.

articleTitle: Insulation materials and energy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: An overview of the materials used in the construction industry in the context of environmental protection and sustainable development has been made. The emphasis is placed on the advantages of thermal insulation materials based on polymer foam. Different types of insulation materials used for indoor or outdoor installation have been studied and evaluated. The composition, structure, production methods and characteristics of the respective products are clarified. A study of the energy efficiency of a single family residential building is presented, in which energy consumption is reduced to 50% using 40 mm sheets of extruded polystyrene.

Author Keywords: expanded and extruded polystyrene foam (EPS and XPS)

articleTitle: Methods for Automated Remote Sensing and Counting of Animals
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Remote sensing and counting of animals is important for both livestock farming and wildlife population management. Traditional surveying methods for manual onsite counting are hard to accomplish, time-consuming, expensive and could be even dangerous. In contrast, remote detection and counting is safe, cost-effective and could be easily and frequently repeated, providing prompt information about animals’ population size and location. This paper reviews some of the most promising potential methods for automated remote detection and counting of animals, ranging from simple computer vision operations like spatial filtering, edge detection, binarization and image subtraction, to more complex machine learning and AI approaches for object detection and recognition. Many scientists worldwide are working on automation of farming and livestock management, and their experimental results really prove the great potential of computer vision and artificial intelligence for achieving that.

articleTitle: Bio Mix Diesel for Significant Lowering of CO2, NOx Emissions and FSN from CI Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The aim of the article is to share the problems of reducing CO2, NOx emissions and FSN from today's vehicles through solutions based on the use of bio components for fuel. An innovative idea is to first prepare a mixture of bio components so that it has the density of the fuel, and then add this mixture to the fuel in greater proportions - here 20% by volume. All this to support the transition to a low-carbon future and meet our global emissions targets under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, while also using bio-waste. The article is a review with the original results of own research in a case study with new (significantly expanded) analyzes that have an important review element regarding the research method and the analysis of its results, which may take the form of a critique of the current method of comparing results and drawing conclusions from them. The case study shows the applicability of the work in practically more regions of the world and provides information on a wider range of renewable and sustainable energy use. The work is particularly important for systems - carbon dioxide accounting in the Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) as it presents a method for the correct assessment of energy (fuel) demand and associated emissions.

articleTitle: Applications of the Ultrafiltration Membranes in the Industrial Effluents Treatment Processes. A Short Review
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The issue of effluents loaded with toxic pollutants resulting from industrial activities, as well as solutions to reduce and eliminate them, is and will be a domain of interest for the vast majority of researchers. On this background, this paper outlines and develops the general elements as well as the current stages of research in the field of Ultrafiltration (UF) Membrane technology applied to various industrial sectors. The parameters and their influence on the efficiency of the UF process, the fundamental characteristics of the materials as well as various solutions for the improvement and maintenance of the membrane materials were also reviewed. Therefore, in order for a membrane material to be as efficient as possible in UF processes, the following aspects must be taken into account: the optimal operating conditions of the UF process, the morphological and hydrophilicity characteristics of the membrane material, as well as the origin and composition of the effluent.

articleTitle: Research of the need for training financial literacy under economic uncertainty in the framework of the educational process at schools
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This The authors identified the current issue of developing entrepreneurial and economic skills from an early age and proposed further research that will affirm or refute this topic. Being university teachers, they observed that the promotion of economic, financial and monetary values can be initiated from school and continued in high school for perfection. A financially educated society is much easier to convince in the case of the state to form fiscal policies, to form monetary strategies, to accept loans, to form financial support programs for both individuals and legal entities. As a result of the widespread research on financial literacy in European countries and China, it is established that the highest level of financial literacy is held by men, as well as students from full-fledged families and parents with a high level, sector level, and literacy through the need to discuss these issues regarding the risks of sakh.com transactions. We conducted a survey of Kazan University students that established the need for and importance of introducing a special financial literacy course into the school process. Competent use of own financial resources to those identified, investment implementation relationship, educational projects, research competitions, financial literacy events among schoolchildren, students and the volume of deposits in banking structures. The higher the level of financial literacy, the more people invest, even in the banking sector

articleTitle: Electric Bicycle Battery Optimization for Lower Cost, Higher Safety, Affordability and Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The world is on the brink of global climate changes and urgent actions are required to reduce pollution. Transport is one of the biggest polluters. Many cities are turning to bicycles as alternative means of transport and are creating and expanding their bicycle networks. Electric bicycles are becoming increasingly popular, but they are still new and their designs are often not well optimized. An analysis of various models of commonly used batteries, in terms of their suitability for use in different types of electric bicycles, has been done. The analysis is based on the results of a long-term study related to the maximum achievable run for a daily used electric bicycle in relation to electric motor powers and available battery chargers. The conclusion is that modern electric bicycles still have certain critical design deficiencies which could be improved. The aim of this work is their designs to be optimized and the operating costs to be reduced, which will make them safer, more competitive and will stimulate their widespread use. This optimization is expected to help for the achievement of the difficult climate goals.
